'''Tiethiagg''' was the first great [[Poet/Legends|poet]] and [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]]. He was adept at understanding the Ithorian's herd culture and its relationship with the individual, and how each individual needed to contribute to the health of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] as a whole. Some sociologists contended that Ithorian culture was largely dedicated to his metaphors.
